title: Microsoft Teams: Improved device settings experience on Teams Rooms on Android
description: We’re enhancing the on-device admin settings experience for Teams Rooms on Android by improving information structure, organization and navigation. These updates make it easier for admins to find, understand, and adjust device settings directly from the console, improving overall usability and efficiency in room management.
